title: PERSONAX: MULTIMODAL DATASETS WITH LLM-INFERRED BEHAVIOR TRAITS

bias_targets.methodology: Applying statistical independence tests (e.g., Chi-Square, KCI, RCIT, HSIC) to measure the dependency between LLM-inferred Big Five behavior/personality traits and gender.
Applying statistical independence tests to measure the dependency between LLM-inferred Big Five behavior/personality traits and birth year, month, and day.
Applying statistical independence tests to measure the dependency between LLM-inferred Big Five behavior/personality traits and occupational categories or sports league affiliations.

Applying statistical independence tests to measure the dependency between LLM-inferred Big Five behavior/personality traits and geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude derived from nationality).

Applying statistical independence tests to measure the dependency between LLM-inferred Big Five behavior/personality traits and physical attributes, including height, weight, and specific facial features (e.g., nose shape, eyebrow prominence).
